objectives.en: Say every fact from one times one to one times twelve without help.
objectives.yo: Sọ gbogbo fact láti one times one dé one times twelve láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Talk every fact from one times one reach one times twelve without help.

objectives.en: Answer any one times fact out of order.
objectives.yo: Dáhùn èyíkéyìí one times fact láìtẹ̀lé ètò.
objectives.pcm: Answer any one times fact wey no follow order.

curriculum.objective: Multiply whole numbers 1 x 1 up to 9 x 9, using a 10 by 10 square chart
curriculum.note: No scheme subdivides the 1x1 to 9x9 block by table; only the term is supported.

say.en: Look at three groups of one mangoes. Today we count in ones.
say.pcm: Look three groups of one mango. Today we go count one one.
say.yo: Wo groups three ti one mango. Lónìí a ó kà ní one one.

say.en: Today you will learn the one times table. Then you will say it by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go learn table one. Then you go talk am by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò kọ́ table one. Lẹ́yìn náà, ìwọ yóò sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.

say.en: Do you remember counting in ones? What is one times two?
say.pcm: You remember how we count one one? One times two na how much?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí bí a ṣe ń kà ní one? Kí ni one times two?

say.en: Three groups of one mango show this. We count one, two, three. One times three is three.
say.pcm: See three groups of one mango: one, two, three. One times three na three.
say.yo: Wo groups mẹ́ta ti one mango: one, two, three. One times three jẹ́ three.

say.en: Say it with me: one times three is three.
say.pcm: Say am with me: one times three na three.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ mi: one times three jẹ́ three.

say.en: Say the one times table. Start with one times one. End with one times twelve.
say.pcm: Say table one. Start with one times one. End with one times twelve.
say.yo: Sọ table one. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú one times one. Parí pẹ̀lú one times twelve.

say.en: Let us fix the ones you missed. Listen, then say them with me.
say.pcm: Make we fix the ones you miss. Hear them, then say them with me.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn tí o pàdánù ṣe. Gbọ́, lẹ́yìn náà sọ wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ mi.

say.pcm: One times seven na how much?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we check the one times table once more. Then we start the two times table.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go check table one again. Then we start table two.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ṣàyẹ̀wò table one. Lẹ́yìn náà a ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ table two.
